background: The Northern Trust Company is the operating bank of Northern Trust, a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager whose business is asset servicing for institutions and banking for wealthy families rather than mass-market lending.
synthesis: The bank is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook. Capital is mixed against US peers: CET1 of 11.8% is in the bottom quarter, while leverage of 6.8% is in the top quarter. LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter, though a custody balance sheet is built differently from a lender's, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days; a conservative fee-earning bank with high ratings and modest ratio headroom.
